question: Which parts of the existing Lab 005 spacetime ILP and JIT age gate reproduce published source structure, and which parts remain generic scaffolding rather than a D4 or D(S3) fault-tolerant decoder?

source_match_matrix.evidence: Binary physical-event, measurement-error, and one-hot local fusion-channel variables implement the blocks of Eq. (18).
Per-site, per-species equalities implement the three Eq. (19) incidences and temporal continuation through previous_site.
Exactly one caller-supplied syndrome-compatible channel is selected at every site, matching Eq. (20).
Jing maximizes log weights in Eq. (21); SciPy minimizes. The adapter now states that callers must supply negative log weights or equivalent additive costs.

The compiler does not construct F_(a,Delta); the caller must supply the allowed channels. A two-species Fig. 4(c/d)-type fixture verifies that changing measured syndrome changes the allowed temporal explanation.
Q is the side length of the smallest axis-aligned spacetime cube; a cluster defers exactly when a defect or inferred correction element is younger than Q, i.e. after t-Q.

source_match_matrix.component: JIT cluster correction and defect removal
source_match_matrix.evidence: Committed defects are removed, but no correction circuit, physical fusion, or measurement-record reversal is performed.
No nearest-absorber metric, absorbing-region state, or age reset relative to an ungauging boundary exists.
No phase/boundary branch, ungauging, neutrality test, non-neutral deferral, re-gauging, or linked-cluster semantics exists.
The compiler has no complete D4 fusion-channel table, D(S3) circuit adapter, noisy repeated herald channel, or lattice-scale decoder.

audit_corrections: Made the JIT clock monotone and transactional: rejected calls no longer advance time or partially commit earlier clusters.
Required each supplied cluster set to partition every unresolved defect exactly once, with unique cluster and defect identifiers.
Rejected negative/future defect and correction times.
Required unique ILP site, physical-event, and within-site channel labels so selected outputs remain unambiguous.
Documented the required sign conversion between the paper's maximum-log-weight objective and SciPy's minimization convention.

jit_invariants: time reversal and incomplete partitions rejected
duplicate new defect identifiers rejected transactionally
ilp_invariants: temporal string continues into the next site
measured syndrome changes an allowed non-Abelian channel
inconsistent incoming temporal channel is infeasible
ambiguous labels and non-finite channel costs rejected

claim_boundary: The ILP algebra and Jing Algorithm-1 age predicate are bounded structural preflights. They are not a complete Jing just-in-time decoder, a Lyons-Brown D(S3) reproduction, a D4 noisy-measurement decoder, a schedule comparison, a threshold, or fault tolerance.
next_gate: Register and implement the missing deferred-record propagation plus an explicit schedule-state layer that distinguishes the Jing ILP baseline from the Lyons-Brown absorber/ungauging branch; do not attach either to noisy D4 data until the physical channel is registered.
